name_zh: 威廉一世/荷兰/奥兰治/独立战争/东印度公司/海上马车夫
name_en: William I/Netherlands/Orange/Independence War/East India Company/Sea Carrier
description_zh: 威廉一世 (1772-1843) 荷兰首任国王，奥兰治-拿骚家族首领，领导荷兰独立战争摆脱法国统治，建立联合王国，扩张东印度公司 (VOC) 亚洲贸易网络，确立荷兰海上马车夫地位，加尔文主义宽容传统奠定国家基因。
description_en: William I (1772-1843) Netherlands first king, Orange-Nassau family head, led Dutch independence war against French rule, established United Kingdom, expanded VOC Asian trade network, established Dutch sea carrier status, Calvinist tolerance tradition founded national genes.
reason_zh: 威廉一世代表小国如何通过海上贸易与殖民网络成为全球经济枢纽，展示了加尔文主义宽容传统如何转化为商业竞争优势，其东印度公司模式开创了跨国公司先河。
reason_en: William I represents how small nation becomes global economic hub through maritime trade and colonial network, demonstrating how Calvinist tolerance tradition transforms into commercial competitive advantage, his VOC model pioneering multinational corporation prototype.
steps_zh: 研究威廉早年奥兰治家族/流亡英国/普鲁士军官
分析1813年独立战争/1815年维也纳会议/联合王国建立
探讨VOC亚洲贸易网络/香料垄断/巴达维亚总督府
评估加尔文主义宽容/宗教自由/商业自由传统
总结奥兰治精神/东印度公司/海上马车夫/加尔文宽容四重遗产
steps_en: Study William early Orange family/British exile/Prussian officer
Analyze 1813 independence war/1815 Vienna Congress/United Kingdom founding
Explore VOC Asian trade network/spice monopoly/Batavia Governor-General
Evaluate Calvinist tolerance/religious freedom/commercial freedom tradition
Summarize Orange spirit/VOC/sea carriage/Calvinist tolerance quadruple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握小国如何通过海上贸易殖民网络跃升全球枢纽，理解加尔文主义宽容如何转化为商业竞争力，评估威廉一世对荷兰黄金时代与现代跨国公司的奠基贡献。
expected_en: Master how small nation becomes global hub via maritime trade, grasp Calvinist tolerance transforming into commercial advantage, evaluate William I foundational contribution to Dutch Golden Age and modern MNCs.
case_zh: 1813 独立战争；1815 维也纳会议/国王；1824 英荷条约；1840 退位。奥兰治精神/东印度公司/海上马车夫/加尔文宽容范式永存。
case_en: 1813 independence war; 1815 Vienna Congress/king; 1824 Anglo-Dutch treaty; 1840 abdication. Orange spirit/VOC/sea carriage/Calvinist tolerance paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Dutch Republicanism / Calvinist Capitalism / Maritime Trade
cross_cultural_impact: Dutch independence; VOC; maritime trade; Calvinist tolerance; constitutional monarchy
